en.title: Taipei Bus Network & Service Coverage Decision Support
en.summary: From official route, stop and published-schedule records to reproducible network-documentation investigation priorities.
en.maturityLabel: Completed network inventory and published-service documentation review POC
en.reviewNote: Network/documentation review is implemented; direction-specific published-service comparison and historical actual-service performance remain evidence-gated.
en.intendedUsers: Municipal transit analysts, public-data engineers and bus-network researchers allocating limited source/documentation investigation capacity.
implementedCapabilities: Eight official PTO feeds with original-byte provenance
Main-route, subsidiary, operator and stop-sequence identity resolution
Deterministic documentation tiers and main-route balancing
Content-addressed static details and JSON/CSV evidence briefings

sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: How can official bus network and schedule records become an explainable, reproducible municipal investigation-priority system when actual service-performance evidence is incomplete? Counting routes or stops alone cannot establish sufficient service.

Published infrastructure, documented service, actual service delivery, passenger demand, accessibility and transport equity are different populations and questions. The objective is to allocate limited investigation capacity, not prescribe service cuts or investment. Intended users are municipal transit analysts, public-data engineers and bus-network researchers.

sections.title: Independent Policy #5 in an Existing Traffic Explorer
paragraphs: taipei-crash-map began with accident exploration and later added independent Policy #4 Neihu traffic-observation readiness. Policy #5 adds a separate transit domain, source contracts, identity models, published-time parsing and review engine in the same repository.

Existing accident and congestion modules remain separate. Their metrics do not contribute to bus tiers; shared deployment and interface patterns do not make their methods interchangeable. Case 006 and Case 007 intentionally reference one root project.

sections.title: Official PTO Acquisition and Eight Distinct Record Units
paragraphs: Eight official Taipei Public Transportation Office (PTO) production gzip feeds, documented by API v6.3, were acquired on 2026-10-21: 5,586,935 compressed original bytes. Rebuilding on 2026-10-22 reused retained inputs and did not acquire new live data. The source catalogue/specification, production feed, retrieval timestamp, publisher update and validated derived snapshot remain distinct.

GetRoute.gz: 800 main-route/variant/operator records; GetStop.gz: 28,826 route-specific stop posts; GetStopLocation.gz: 5,376 physical stop locations; GetPathDetail.gz: 43,447 route-variant stop occurrences. These network feeds support their verified identity roles, not passenger coverage.

GetSemiTimeTable.gz: 3,280 published headway windows; GetTimeTable.gz: 35,465 published timetable records; GetBusShape.gz: 1,028 geometry metadata rows; GetSpecTimeTable.gz: 282 special preplanned schedule entries. These four sources remain limited for schedule direction, geometry freshness or calendar interpretation. The eight counts are not interchangeable or additive service totals.

PTO source attribution, original compressed hashes, byte sizes and acquisition/Last-Modified values remain in the retained manifest. Publisher update strings are not operational event times. TDX is separately audited; no authenticated actual-service history, Taipei historical completeness or stable event crosswalk was acquired.

sections.title: Entity Resolution: Main Routes, Subsidiaries and Operators
paragraphs: The 800 Route rows resolve to 416 distinct main-route IDs, 731 subsidiary PathAttributeId values and 773 distinct main-route/variant/operator associations. The 27 repeated association rows are not automatically invalid variants. Operator IDs are retained as arrays rather than duplicating investigation candidates.

Source namespace + main route + subsidiary + stop-derived direction form the original composite candidate ID, such as pto:10419:104190:0. Display route names are labels, not join keys. Stop.routeId resolves to the main route, while PathDetail.pathAttributeId resolves to the subsidiary; nearby geometry or similar names cannot repair ambiguous identity.

sections.title: Stop Posts, Physical Locations and Ordered Occurrences
paragraphs: All 28,826 Stop.routeId references resolve to main-route identities; no PathDetail.stopId or Stop.stopLocationId references remain unresolved. A route-specific stop post is not a unique physical location: 28,826 posts and 5,376 locations describe different units.

PathDetail occurrence IDs and StopSequence preserve repeated visits on circular routes. PathDetail.Type is not direction; Stop.goBack supplies outbound/return, with unknown left explicit. Sequence checks compare adjacent values within a verified subsidiary/direction without assuming each directional split starts at 1.

The 212 unresolved subsidiary references in PathDetail are retained as quality exceptions and excluded from verified candidate inventory. Successful stop/location joins do not erase those exceptions or justify invented route-stop relationships.

sections.title: Network Geometry and Geographic Boundaries
paragraphs: The normalized inventory has 1,241 subsidiary/direction candidates, with 216 exact main-route + subsidiary + direction geometry matches. Main-route shapes are retained separately; they are not substituted for an exact subsidiary shape. Valid WGS84 LINESTRING coordinates support route display without manufacturing missing geometry.

The PTO network includes cross-border records. Network scope does not establish Taipei-only district coverage, pedestrian catchments, population access or district diversity. Shape row utime can be years older than feed retrieval; row-level geometry freshness remains unverified. No stop-proximity or route-overlap measure becomes accessibility, inefficiency or equity.

sections.title: Published Service and Service-Day Time Semantics
paragraphs: Raw timetable strings and headway fields are retained. Time parsing accepts HH:mm or HHmm through 47:59; an end clock before its start rolls into the next service day in Asia/Taipei. This is interpretation of a published window, not an observed departure or arrival.

Only unambiguous positive headways or explicit ordered ranges such as 10～15分 are parsed. Compact 0510, inverted ranges and natural-language descriptions remain unresolved; LongHeadway and LowHeadway are not silently swapped. Published dispatch/headway documentation is not actual achieved frequency or passenger waiting time.

sections.title: Calendars and Unresolved Direction Applicability
paragraphs: Native DateType 0 accepts weekday 1=Sunday through 7=Saturday; DateType 1 accepts valid YYYYMMDD special dates. Unsupported encodings and impossible dates remain unresolved. A valid date is not verification of holiday or service-exception applicability.

Timetables join subsidiaries but lack accepted directional assignment. Raw schedules remain inspectable and are not copied to both directions. Main-route first/last text stays main-route metadata rather than being duplicated across subsidiaries. Special preplanned schedules remain plans, not executed trips.

sections.title: Three Separate Evidence Objectives
paragraphs: Eligible network/documentation investigations: 1,241
Eligible direction-specific published-service comparisons: 0
Eligible historical actual-service performance candidates: 0

Quality review can investigate verified source relationships and limited published documentation. Timetable direction is unresolved, and no comparable executed-trip population or missed-trip/reliability denominator was acquired. Zero eligible does not mean zero observed bus service, zero buses or verified service shortage.

sections.title: Architecture and Static Evidence Delivery
paragraphs: Bounded offline acquisition checks raw bytes and schemas, resolves route/stop/sequence identities and publishes immutable, versioned manifests and indexed route details. Pure TypeScript functions provide review selection to the bilingual React dashboard and evidence-backed JSON/CSV briefings.

There is no new production backend or database. Visitors do not trigger acquisition or offline joins. Portfolio renders typed narrative and compact tables; it does not fetch full bus datasets, execute the upstream engine or recalculate scenarios.

sections.title: Issue-Code Precedence and Deterministic Review Rules
paragraphs: bus-network-service-evidence-review-v1, schema/configuration 1.0.0, classifies source-investigation questions. The first matching issue category sets A/B/C: primary identity/stop/sequence issues precede published-service ambiguities, then other documentation/geometry monitoring. No issue-count weighting, numerical shortage score or Neihu speed/completeness threshold is reused.

Evidence Gaps First orders eligible units by A/B/C then stable ASCII composite ID. Balanced Main-route Review groups that ordering by verified main route, orders groups by their best candidate and takes one per route per round. It may take another route's lower-tier candidate before revisiting a route; that is research representation, not an expected-benefit estimate.

Actual quality tiers are A=163, B=927, C=151. Capacity counts investigations, not trips or route budgets. Strict mode requires usable source references, complete identity and network scope; broader inclusion permits ambiguity investigation without verifying the join or enabling directional/historical service analysis.

sections.title: Actual Capacity and Main-Route Representation
paragraphs: Fixed scope: pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952, strict quality eligibility, all retained route/variant/direction candidates and one quality-review objective. Both strategies select 5 at capacity 5: Evidence Gaps First covers 2 main routes and balanced covers 5, with 3 added / 3 removed candidate IDs. At capacity 10 both select 10, covering 5 versus 10 main routes with 5 added / 5 removed.

Unlimited selects the same 1,241-candidate set across 416 main routes, although order can differ. Added/removed counts compare balanced against evidence gaps on the same population; they are not newly discovered service gaps. Concentrating on several high-priority issues within a main route and spreading investigations across routes are explicit tradeoffs, not proven fairness or effectiveness.

The ordered shortlist table contains actual retained-edition outputs: ranks 1–5 are each strategy's capacity-5 selection, and ranks 1–10 are its capacity-10 selection. These original IDs are not synthetic examples.

Actual pto:10419:104190:0 is A with missing-geometry, sequence-gap and undirected-schedule. Actual pto:10432:10432:1 also has inverted-headway, missing-geometry, sequence-gap and undirected-schedule. A takes precedence because of sequence-gap. Both ask: Verify source identity and ordered route-stop relationships. Neither is a recommended service cut, investment or confirmed passenger shortage.

sections.title: Sensitivity Includes an Unchanged Result
paragraphs: Strict and broader ambiguity-review inclusion both yield 1,241 quality candidates in this retained edition. Independently checked capacities 5, 10 and unlimited preserve selection under both strategies: 0 added and 0 removed. No artificial effect is introduced.

The inclusion rule is nevertheless a different evidence scope. This tested identity-eligibility sensitivity does not stand in for future source-edition, direction or timetable-semantic changes. Different editions, filters, objective or evidence populations require scope warnings; unchanged selection does not validate ambiguous records or demonstrate policy benefit.

sections.title: Performance and On-Demand Route Details
paragraphs: Upstream measured root manifest 83,384 bytes plus initial snapshot/index 563,601 bytes: 646,985 initial bus JSON bytes before compression, only on tab entry. There are 420 referenced public files, including 416 lazy route details; this initial total is not the whole archive or app transfer.

Lazy bus-dashboard JavaScript is 16.27 kB gzip; selected-route map plotting is capped at 140 occurrences. Local balanced capacity-10 computation averaged 0.3622 ms across 10,000 iterations. Local manifest/index/detail read-and-parse observations were 32.8 / 11.2 / 4.4 ms. These are upstream local measurements, not public-host or mobile visitor latency guarantees.

sections.title: Manifest Integrity, Safe Publication and Briefings
paragraphs: Snapshot pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952, Git merge e01b651d66cedfb5106c263088dc99fbc5d5e3b8 and root manifest SHA256 00c1f33198ef811a46bddc784119063b2ce3174c5dbe3224ba0b662098d02b7b identify different objects. Generation remains 2026-10-21T07:08:16.679Z; deterministic 22 October rebuilding does not refresh the acquisition date.

Manifests pin immutable paths, exact bytes and SHA256. Browser validation checks bytes before parsing; schema, counts, relationships, official URL allowlists, acquisition dates and nested synthetic/test markers are checked. A checksum proves agreement with a manifest, not an independent publisher signature. Atomic manifest publication retains the previous good edition if acquisition, validation or writing fails.

Briefings retain source hashes/URLs, snapshot, filters, inclusion assumptions, selected/excluded real candidates, comparisons and limitations. CSV quoting and formula-prefix guards include leading whitespace/control characters. No credentials, vehicle traces or synthetic production observations are published.

sections.title: Recorded Verification and Independent Checks
paragraphs: Upstream delivery records 99 tests across 7 files, 11 relevant GitHub Pages bus/Neihu integration checks, root and Pages builds, deterministic output checks, desktop/mobile review and actual JSON/CSV downloads. No new dependencies were introduced; the source release recorded two moderate dependency advisories. These are upstream recorded results, separate from Portfolio verification.

Portfolio independently checked the exact 83,384-byte manifest hash, four index/report references and two route-detail artifacts, then used original assertions and pure functions to verify actual capacities, strategy differences and strict/broader equality. This did not validate all 416 detail bodies, rerun source ETL/acquisition or rerun the full source suite.

PR #9 is merged as confirmed by GitHub metadata; older open-PR wording is historical. Inspected screenshots are upstream local research verification: Chinese desktop, English mobile and English selected-route detail, not government operating-system or independently accepted public-deployment captures.

sections.title: Responsible Use and Historical Evidence Gates
paragraphs: Independent engineering POC, not government endorsement or an adopted transport plan. The work does not establish bus shortages, actual frequency, historical reliability, missed trips, demand, walking accessibility, verified district coverage, transport equity, overlap inefficiency or benefits from cuts/investments. Schedule/calendar direction and row-level geometry freshness remain unresolved.

Historical analysis requires eleven explicit gates: legal official access, verified identity, actual event semantics, timezone, service day, stable crosswalk, comparable windows, duplicate handling, expected/observed completeness, exceptions/holidays and outage handling. Estimated arrivals, GPS positions and published plans are not completed service events.

The separately typed historical engine can examine actual arrival/departure intervals only after every gate passes, preserving candidate/stop/service-day/semantics groups and rejecting conflicting event identities. It does not infer missed trips, executed-trip totals or reliability scores. All-gates-passed fixtures are synthetic tests, not production evidence.

sections.title: What This Demonstrates and What Evidence Comes Next
paragraphs: Backend-oriented integration, heterogeneous schema reconciliation, route-stop identity, data governance, reproducible ETL, source contracts, GIS, deterministic review rules, static lazy loading and explainable exports form a completed evidence-aware research system. This does not imply a production backend, procurement contract or officially adopted policy.

Official Sources → Identity and Sequence Resolution → Published-Service Semantics → Evidence Eligibility → Reproducible Investigation Scenarios. Future precision must follow authoritative direction/calendar links and actual service evidence rather than treating more published records as proof of transport outcomes.

tiers.caption: First matching issue category determines the review tier

cells.rule: missing-stop, broken-route-stop, route-stop-conflict, missing-location, invalid-coordinate, unknown-direction, ambiguous-route, duplicate-sequence, sequence-gap, missing-sequence, source-version-mismatch, orphan-variant. Verify source identity and ordered route-stop relationships.
Without A: undirected-schedule, schedule-conflict, calendar-ambiguity, missing-timetable, invalid-time, inverted-headway. Clarify direction and calendar applicability.

notes: Evidence Gaps First: A/B/C then stable ASCII composite ID; no issue-count weight or random tie break. Balanced groups verified main routes by best candidate rank and round-robins ordered route queues.
Capacity 5, 10 or unlimited (null) truncates eligible investigations. Invalid capacities fail explicitly. Main-route representation is not passenger, district or equity coverage.
Broader inclusion never verifies ambiguous identity or opens published-direction/history gates. Snapshot editions, filters, objective and inclusion assumptions define comparison scope.
Actual quality population 1,241 (A 163 / B 927 / C 151). Direction-specific published service and historical actual service each remain at 0 eligible.

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 當實際服務表現證據不足時，如何將官方公車路網與班表轉成可解釋、可重現的市政調查優先系統？僅計算路線或站牌數，無法證明服務足夠。
公告設施、文件服務、實際服務、旅客需求、可及性與運輸公平，是不同母體與問題。目標是配置有限調查量能，不是建議減班或投資。預期使用者為市政運輸分析人員、公開資料工程師與公車路網研究人員。

sections.title: 既有交通探索中的獨立 Policy #5
paragraphs: taipei-crash-map 起於事故探索，後加入獨立 Policy #4 內湖交通觀測就緒度。Policy #5 在同一儲存庫新增獨立大眾運輸領域、來源契約、身分模型、公告時間解析與查核引擎。
既有事故與壅塞模組維持獨立，其指標不參與公車層級；共用部署與介面不代表方法可互換。案例 006 與 007 刻意對應同一根專案。

sections.title: 官方公運處擷取與八種不同紀錄單位
paragraphs: 依 API v6.3，2026-10-21 取得八個臺北市公共運輸處（PTO）正式 gzip 資料源，原始壓縮位元組合計 5,586,935。2026-10-22 重建沿用保留輸入，不是新即時擷取。來源目錄／規格、正式資料、取得時間、發布者更新與已驗證衍生快照各自區分。
GetRoute.gz：800 筆主路線／附屬路線／業者紀錄；GetStop.gz：28,826 筆路線特定站牌；GetStopLocation.gz：5,376 個實體站位；GetPathDetail.gz：43,447 筆附屬路線站點出現紀錄。這些路網來源支援經驗證身分用途，不是旅客服務涵蓋。
GetSemiTimeTable.gz：3,280 個公告班距時間窗；GetTimeTable.gz：35,465 筆公告班表；GetBusShape.gz：1,028 筆幾何中繼資料；GetSpecTimeTable.gz：282 筆特殊預排班表。四者因班表方向、幾何新鮮度或日曆適用性維持有限證據，八種數量不可互換或加總為服務量。
公運處來源標示、原始壓縮雜湊、位元組及擷取／Last-Modified 時間保留於原始清單。發布者更新字串不是營運事件時間。TDX 另行稽核，未取得認證實際服務歷史、臺北歷史完整性或穩定事件對照。

sections.title: 實體調和：主路線、附屬路線與業者
paragraphs: 800 筆 Route 紀錄解析為 416 個不同主路線 ID、731 個附屬 PathAttributeId，以及 773 個不同主路線／附屬路線／業者關聯。27 筆重複關聯不自動等於無效附屬路線；業者 ID 保留為陣列，不複製查核候選。
來源命名空間＋主路線＋附屬路線＋由站牌取得的方向，組成原始候選 ID，例如 pto:10419:104190:0。路線名稱僅是標籤，不是連結鍵。Stop.routeId 對應主路線，PathDetail.pathAttributeId 對應附屬路線；鄰近幾何或相似名稱不能修補歧義身分。

sections.title: 站牌、實體站位與有序出現紀錄
paragraphs: 全部 28,826 筆 Stop.routeId 均對應主路線；PathDetail.stopId 與 Stop.stopLocationId 無未解參照。路線特定站牌不是唯一實體位置，28,826 個站牌與 5,376 個站位屬不同單位。
PathDetail 出現 ID 與 StopSequence 保留環狀路線重複到訪。PathDetail.Type 不是方向，Stop.goBack 提供去／返，未知維持明示。站序只在已驗證附屬路線／方向內比較相鄰值，不假設每個方向分段從 1 開始。
PathDetail 的 212 筆未解附屬路線參照保留為品質例外，排除於已驗證候選盤點。站牌／站位連結成功，不抹除這些例外，也不允許虛構路線站點關係。

sections.title: 路網幾何與地理邊界
paragraphs: 標準化盤點有 1,241 個附屬路線／方向候選，其中 216 個具精確主路線＋附屬路線＋方向幾何匹配。主路線幾何另存，不替代附屬路線精確幾何。有效 WGS84 LINESTRING 座標支援路線顯示，不製造缺漏線段。
公運處路網含跨市紀錄，路網範圍不證明臺北行政區涵蓋、人行服務圈、人口可及性或行政區多樣性。Shape 列的 utime 可能比擷取早多年，逐列幾何新鮮度仍未驗證。站點鄰近或路線重疊不轉成可及性、無效率或公平指標。

sections.title: 公告服務與服務日時間語意
paragraphs: 原始班表字串及班距欄位保留。時間解析接受 HH:mm 或 HHmm 至 47:59；結束鐘面早於開始時，依 Asia/Taipei 推至下一服務日。這是公告時間窗解讀，不是實際發車或到站。
僅解析明確正班距或明示有序範圍，例如 10～15分。緊接字串 0510、反向範圍或自然語言維持未解，LongHeadway／LowHeadway 不默默交換。公告發車／班距文件不等於實際達成頻率或旅客候車時間。

sections.title: 日曆與未解方向適用性
paragraphs: 原生 DateType 0 接受星期 1=週日至 7=週六，DateType 1 接受有效 YYYYMMDD 特殊日期。不支援編碼與不可能日期維持未解；日期有效不代表已驗證假日或服務例外適用性。
班表可連到附屬路線，但沒有合格方向指派。原始班表仍可檢視，不複製到去返兩向；主路線首末班文字維持主路線資料，不複製到各附屬路線。特殊預排班表仍是計畫，不是已執行班次。

sections.title: 三個獨立證據目標
paragraphs: 合格路網／文件調查：1,241
合格方向特定公告服務比較：0
合格歷史實際服務表現候選：0
品質查核可調查已驗證來源關係與有限公告文件。班表方向未解，亦未取得可比較已執行班次母體或漏班／可靠度分母。零合格不等於零觀察公車服務、零公車或已驗證服務不足。

sections.title: 架構與靜態證據交付
paragraphs: 有界離線擷取驗證原始位元組與結構、調和路線／站牌／站序身分，再發布不可變版本清單與路線細節索引。純 TypeScript 函式為雙語 React 儀表板提供查核選取，以及具證據 JSON／CSV 簡報。
未新增正式後端或資料庫，訪客不觸發擷取或離線連結。作品集呈現型別化敘述與小表格，不下載完整公車資料、不執行上游引擎，也不重算情境。

sections.title: 問題代碼優先規則與確定性查核
paragraphs: bus-network-service-evidence-review-v1，結構／設定 1.0.0，分類來源調查問題。第一個符合問題類別決定 A／B／C：主要身分／站點／站序先於公告服務歧義，再來是其他文件／幾何監測。不使用問題數加權、服務不足分數，亦不沿用內湖速率／完整率門檻。
缺口優先依 A／B／C，再依穩定 ASCII 複合 ID 排序。主路線均衡依已驗證主路線分組，以各組最高候選排序，再每輪各取一個；可能先取另一主路線較低層級，再回訪原路線。這是研究代表性，不是效益估計。
實際品質層級為 A=163、B=927、C=151。容量計算調查，不是班次或路線預算。嚴格模式需可用來源、完整身分與路網範圍；較廣納入只容許歧義調查，不驗證連結或開放方向／歷史服務分析。

sections.title: 實際容量與主路線代表性
paragraphs: 固定範圍：pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952、嚴格品質資格、全部保留路線／附屬路線／方向候選與同一品質目標。容量 5 兩策略皆取 5 個，缺口優先涵蓋 2 條主路線、均衡涵蓋 5 條，3 個 ID 新增、3 個移除。容量 10 皆取 10 個，涵蓋 5 與 10 條主路線，5 個新增、5 個移除。
不限容量皆選相同 1,241 個候選集合、416 條主路線，順序可不同。新增／移除是均衡相對缺口在同母體的比較，不是新發現服務缺口。同主路線查多個高優先問題，或分散至更多主路線，是明示取捨，不證明公平或成效較佳。
有序名單表為保留版本的實際輸出：各策略第 1–5 名是容量 5 選取，第 1–10 名是容量 10 選取。原始 ID 不是合成範例。

實際 pto:10419:104190:0 為 A，含 missing-geometry、sequence-gap、undirected-schedule。pto:10432:10432:1 另含 inverted-headway，並有 missing-geometry、sequence-gap、undirected-schedule；sequence-gap 使 A 優先。兩者問題皆為核實來源身分與有序路線站點關係，不是建議減班、投資或已確認旅客服務不足。

sections.title: 敏感度也包含不變結果
paragraphs: 此保留版本的嚴格與較廣歧義納入皆產生 1,241 個品質候選。獨立檢查容量 5、10、不限，兩策略的選取在兩納入設定下相同，0 個新增、0 個移除，不製造人工效果。
納入規則仍構成不同證據範圍。這次身分資格敏感度不能替代未來來源版本、方向或班表語意變動。版本、篩選、目標或母體不同須明示範圍警語；選取不變不驗證歧義紀錄，也不代表政策效益。

sections.title: 效能與按需路線細節
paragraphs: 上游量測根清單 83,384 位元組、初始快照／索引 563,601 位元組，公車頁籤進入時初始 JSON 合計 646,985 位元組（壓縮前）。420 個參照公開檔案含 416 個延遲路線細節；初始量不是全部封存或整個應用傳輸量。
公車儀表板 JavaScript 為 16.27 kB gzip，選定路線地圖最多繪製 140 次站點出現。均衡容量 10 在本機 10,000 次平均 0.3622 ms，清單／索引／細節讀取解析為 32.8／11.2／4.4 ms。這是上游本機量測，不是公開主機或手機訪客延遲保證。

sections.title: 清單完整性、安全發布與簡報
paragraphs: 快照 pto-bus-0b70f80504e5b952、Git 合併 e01b651d66cedfb5106c263088dc99fbc5d5e3b8，以及根清單 SHA256 00c1f33198ef811a46bddc784119063b2ce3174c5dbe3224ba0b662098d02b7b 是不同物件。產製維持 2026-10-21T07:08:16.679Z，22 日確定性重建不刷新取得日期。
清單固定不可變路徑、精確位元組與 SHA256，瀏覽器先驗證位元組再解析。結構、數量、關係、官方 URL 白名單、取得日期及巢狀合成／測試標記皆檢查。校驗碼證明符合清單，不是獨立發布者簽章。原子清單發布在取得、驗證或寫入失敗時保留前次有效版本。
簡報保留來源雜湊／URL、快照、篩選、納入假設、實際候選選取／排除、比較與限制。CSV 引號與公式前綴防護包含前置空白／控制字元。不發布憑證、車輛軌跡或合成正式觀測。

sections.title: 已記錄驗證與獨立檢查
paragraphs: 上游交付記錄 7 個檔案共 99 項測試、11 項相關 GitHub Pages 公車／內湖整合檢查、根路徑與 Pages 建置、確定性輸出、桌面／行動版及實際 JSON／CSV 下載。未新增依賴，來源版本記錄兩項中度依賴警示。這是上游結果，與作品集驗證分開。
作品集獨立檢查精確 83,384 位元組清單雜湊、四個索引／報告參照及兩個路線細節，再以原始斷言及純函式核對實際容量、策略差異與嚴格／較廣相同結果。未驗證全部 416 個細節內容，未重跑上游 ETL／擷取或完整來源測試。
GitHub 中繼資料確認 PR #9 已合併，較早未合併敘述屬歷史。已檢視截圖為上游本機研究驗證：中文桌面、英文行動版、英文選定路線，不是政府作業系統或獨立驗收公開部署。

sections.title: 負責任使用與歷史證據門檻
paragraphs: 獨立工程 POC，不是政府背書或採用的運輸計畫。未證明公車服務不足、實際頻率、歷史可靠度、漏班、需求、人行可及性、有效行政區涵蓋、運輸公平、重疊無效率或減班／投資效益。班表／日曆方向與逐列幾何新鮮度仍未解。
歷史分析需十一個明確門檻：合法官方存取、已驗證身分、實際事件語意、時區、服務日、穩定對照、可比較時間窗、重複處理、預期／觀察完整性、例外／假日及遙測中斷處理。預估到站、GPS 位置與公告計畫不是完成服務事件。
獨立型別的歷史引擎只在全部通過後，依候選／站牌／服務日／語意分組檢查實際到離站間隔，拒絕衝突事件身分。不推定漏班、已執行班次總數或可靠度分數；全門檻通過範例是合成測試，不是正式證據。

sections.title: 展現的工程能力與下一步證據
paragraphs: 後端導向整合、異質結構調和、路線站牌身分、資料治理、可重現 ETL、來源契約、GIS、確定性查核、靜態延遲載入與可解釋匯出，構成完整證據研究系統，不代表正式後端、採購契約或官方政策採用。
官方來源 → 身分與站序調和 → 公告服務語意 → 證據資格 → 可重現調查情境。精度應由權威方向／日曆連結與實際服務證據支持，不把更多公告紀錄當成運輸成效。

tiers.caption: 第一個符合問題類別決定查核層級

cells.rule: missing-stop、broken-route-stop、route-stop-conflict、missing-location、invalid-coordinate、unknown-direction、ambiguous-route、duplicate-sequence、sequence-gap、missing-sequence、source-version-mismatch、orphan-variant。核實來源身分與有序路線站點關係。
未符合 A 時：undirected-schedule、schedule-conflict、calendar-ambiguity、missing-timetable、invalid-time、inverted-headway。釐清方向與日曆適用性。
未符合 A／B 時：其他含 missing-geometry 問題，或無 A／B 問題。複核路網文件與幾何脈絡。

notes: 缺口優先依 A／B／C，再以穩定 ASCII 複合 ID；不按問題數加權或隨機同分排序。均衡依主路線最佳候選排序，再輪流選取各路線佇列。
容量 5、10 或不限（null）截取合格調查，不合法容量明確失敗。主路線代表性不是旅客、行政區或公平涵蓋。
較廣納入不驗證歧義身分，也不開放公告方向／歷史門檻。快照版本、篩選、目標及納入假設定義比較範圍。
實際品質母體 1,241（A 163／B 927／C 151），方向特定公告服務與歷史實際服務皆為 0 合格。
